m-icon-resolution-for-print-business-car.alt: A business card drawn to scale with an orange side panel, placeholder contact lines and small solid phone, mail, globe and map pin icons, overlaid with dashed bleed, solid trim and dotted safe area guides and a callout on the phone icon

m-icon-resolution-for-print-rgb-cmyk.alt: Two panels: a laptop screen in a dim room shows a rocket icon glowing in vivid electric blue, labelled RGB light, and a paper card shows the same rocket printed in a slightly deeper blue with cyan, magenta, yellow and black ink dots, labelled CMYK ink

m-icon-resolution-for-print-vector-vs-pn.alt: The same line printer icon enlarged in two big circles: on the left from an SVG or PDF with perfectly crisp lines, on the right from a 64 px PNG with visible square pixels, each with a magnifier on one rounded corner

m-icons-in-excel-and-google-sheets-picto.alt: A chart with three bars of the same 4,500 value: a plain orange bar, one people icon stretched along the bar, and four and a half crisp people icons stacked in a row

m-icons-in-excel-and-google-sheets-statu.alt: Two copies of a five-row task tracker: on the left the Status column shows plain traffic-light dots, on the right it shows a green tick, amber clock, red warning and grey cross icon

m-icons-in-react-server-components-bound.alt: A two-zone diagram: on the paper Server Components side, layout, nav and page cards with home, search and bell icons send HTML only with 0 KB icon JS to the browser; on the dark use client side, a search box component ships its search icon as JavaScript

m-icons-in-react-server-components-pass-.alt: Two lanes crossing a dashed server and client boundary: icon={Search} passes a function and its arrow is stopped at the line by a red x, while icon={<Search />} passes an element whose arrow crosses into a client button showing the search icon, marked with a green check

m-icons-showing-as-squares-before-after.alt: The same app toolbar twice: before, labelled Icon font failed, the word home and four empty tofu boxes; after an arrow, labelled SVG icons, crisp home, search, bell, settings and user line icons

m-icons-showing-as-squares-three-states.alt: Three browser frames showing the same toolbar button: a clean house icon labelled Font loaded, an empty box with the hex code F015 labelled Font missing: a box, and the plain word home labelled Ligature font missing: the word

m-instagram-highlight-covers-before-afte.alt: Two rows of five highlight circles named Shop, Reviews, FAQ, Menu and Contact: the before row mixes photo crops and five icon styles at odd sizes, the after row uses white solid icons on one orange, centred and the same size

m-instagram-highlight-covers-safe-circle.alt: A square orange 1080 by 1080 cover with a white shopping bag icon inside a dotted safe circle, a dashed circle showing what Instagram displays, hatched corners that get cropped, and the same set of five covers shown tiny in a profile row

m-migrate-icon-font-to-svg-class-swap.alt: A before and after strip on warm paper: an i tag with fa-solid fa-house fa-fw classes drawn from a font file in one colour, and the same i tag with with with-home with-solid with-fw classes showing a real solid home SVG, joined by a curved arrow reading change the class names only

m-optimize-svg-icons-svgo-before-after.alt: Two code cards: on the left the bell icon SVG as a design tool exports it, 1,112 bytes, with its comment, metadata, empty groups, ids and long decimals marked red; on the right the same icon after SVGO, 281 bytes, and between them the two render identically

m-optimize-svg-icons-svgo-svgomg.alt: A generic SVG optimiser window: a bell icon preview with a size readout of 1.09 KB to 0.27 KB, and settings where Remove viewBox, Remove title and Prefer viewBox to width/height are highlighted as kept off, precision is set to 2 and multipass is on

m-optimize-svg-icons-svgo-what-breaks.alt: Four tiles of before and after pairs: removeViewBox leaves a home icon small in the corner of its frame, convertColors with currentColor turns a two-tone home icon flat navy, cleanupIds empties a sprite file, and precision 0 makes a bell outline drift

m-png-to-svg-real-vs-fake.alt: Two cards with the same small orange heart icon and a big magnifier on its edge: the traced SVG shows a smooth curve with pen anchor points, the fake SVG with a PNG inside shows a jagged staircase of pixels

m-png-to-svg-trace-results.alt: Three rows of input PNG to traced SVG with an orange rocket icon: a large flat rocket traces cleanly, a tiny blurry rocket traces into a lumpy shape with melted corners, and a glossy 3D rocket traces into blotchy flat patches

m-powerpoint-icons-missing-flowchart.alt: A flowchart starting at No Icons button, splitting into three questions with violet icons (grey button, no button, opens but fails), each with its fix, all ending at bring your own icons

m-powerpoint-icons-missing-privacy-setti.alt: A generic Account privacy settings panel with three toggles; the switch for experiences that download online content is off and ringed in orange, with a callout showing a greyed-out Icons button

m-sell-products-with-free-icons-cricut-s.alt: Three panels on a green cutting mat: a line-style heart as it looks on screen, the same heart as the blade sees it with only a thin red dashed hairline cut down the middle of its stroke, and a solid heart with a red dashed cut running cleanly round its outer edge

m-sell-products-with-free-icons-product-.alt: Two panels: on the left, under a green tick and Selling a product, a laptop with a cat sticker, a mug printed with small icons and a planner page; on the right, under a red cross and Selling the icons, a ZIP of 50 icon PNGs, fanned PNG files and a clipart bundle tag, noting that most licences forbid this

m-svg-icon-cut-off-or-blurry-blur.alt: Zoomed pixel grids: a wall line on whole pixels makes one solid dark column (crisp), shifted half a pixel it becomes two grey columns (soft); below, the home icon rendered at 24 px and 19.2 px, blown up to show its pixels

m-svg-icon-cut-off-or-blurry-clipped.alt: Three cards on graph paper with a dashed red viewBox edge: a circle whose stroke spills over the edge, a bell icon whose right side is cut by a shifted viewBox, and a gear icon clipped top and bottom by a short button, each with a fixed version and a green check

m-svg-icon-cut-off-or-blurry-viewbox.alt: Three cards: a home icon on a 24 by 24 cyan grid labelled viewBox, the same icon filling picture frames of 16, 24 and 48 px labelled width and height, and a 48 px frame with the icon stuck small in its corner labelled no viewBox

m-svg-icons-in-css-class-anatomy.alt: Code diagram: the tag i class with with-home points to two rule cards, the shared .with rule with a 1em box, vertical-align -0.125em and an ::after painted with currentColor through a mask, and the .with-home rule holding one data URI variable, above the home icon beside the word Home in slate, teal and white on navy

m-svg-icons-in-css-mask-anatomy.alt: Exploded isometric diagram of a CSS mask icon: an empty ::before box at the bottom, the same box filled with currentColor in the middle and the with icons external-link icon as a black stencil on top, beside the result: Read the docs with the icon in the link colour

m-svg-icons-in-email-clients.alt: The same newsletter open in three generic email windows: in Apple Mail its four blue contact icons show crisply, in Gmail they show but are tagged PNG, and in Outlook 2016 only empty boxes appear where the icons should be

m-svg-icons-in-email-dark-mode.alt: An email footer split into a light half and a dark half: black outline phone, mail, globe and calendar icons are clear on light but almost vanish on dark, while the same icons in white on blue circles stay clear on both halves

m-svg-icons-in-react-and-nextjs-config-b.alt: Two code editor cards on a pale blueprint grid: a faded Next 15 webpack config rule for SVGR with a red fails next build in 16 tag, and the Next 16 turbopack rules config for svg files with a green works tag

m-svg-icons-in-react-and-nextjs-four-way.alt: A flowchart on a pale blueprint grid: from I have an SVG icon, part of a full icon set leads to an icon component package, otherwise needing CSS colour leads to SVGR and not needing it leads to an img tag, with a side note on sprites

m-svg-in-google-slides-size-guide.alt: A white 16:9 slide with an orange lightbulb icon by a bullet, a rocket in a row of three and a big target, each measured and labelled 256-512 px, 1024 px and 2048 px

m-svg-in-google-slides-wmf-vs-png.alt: Two white panels compare one heart icon zoomed in: after the WMF round trip its curves are straight segments with dots at each corner, while the large PNG version is smooth

m-svg-sprites-how-it-works.alt: A tall card labelled sprite-line.svg listing four symbols, home, search, bell and settings, with their ids, and cyan arrows from the matching icons in a web page sidebar back to each symbol, with a callout reading use href #with-bell

m-svg-sprites-recolour.alt: The same duo home icon from one sprite symbol in three colour sets: navy with sky tint and amber door, green with mint tint and coral door, and white on a dark tile with violet tint and pink door, each with a legend of its CSS values

m-visual-schedule-icons-card-sheet.alt: A printable landscape sheet of twelve square visual schedule cards in a four by three grid, each with a violet duo icon and a bold label from Wake up to Home, dashed cut lines round every card and a bracket showing each card is 2.5 in or 6.4 cm

m-visual-schedule-icons-first-then.alt: A laminated First and Then board on a wooden table, with a kawaii pencil card labelled Writing under First, an arrow, a kawaii playground card labelled Playtime under Then, hook-and-loop dots showing, and a finished envelope with a check mark beside the board
